subject: Opaque session weighting causing unexpected overage — request for sampling and provisional hold
messages:
From: Priya Rao <billing@atrato.ai>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
Cc: Atrato AI Finance <finance@atrato.ai>
Date: Sun, 4 Apr 2027 09:13:00 -0700
Subject: Sharp spike on March invoice — need breakdown and temporary hold

Hi Kimberly,

Hope you're well. We received the March invoice (attached: redwood-invoice-202703.pdf) and are seeing a ~4.8x jump in token consumption versus our February baseline. This looks concentrated around 2027-03-30 02:00–06:00 UTC and again on 2027-03-31 14:00–16:00 UTC. Our integration didn't change during that window — no deploys or traffic shifts on our side.

Could you provide a per-endpoint/per-model breakdown for the two windows above, and any indication of why session weighting or sampling would produce such a spike? We can share request IDs and sample payloads if that helps.

Because this is material to our budget forecast, we'd like to request a provisional hold on collection for the March invoice while this is investigated. We expect to resolve quickly but need the hold to avoid triggering our internal procurement review.

I've attached a small CSV with three representative request IDs we captured in our logs (usage-samples.csv). Happy to hop on a call if helpful.

Thanks —
Priya Rao
Head of Finance, Atrato AI
billing@atrato.ai
Atrato AI

Attachments:
- usage-samples.csv (3 rows)
- redwood-invoice-202703.pdf (invoice stub)

Hi Priya — thanks for flagging this and for sending the request IDs.

I'm looping in Ben (account lead) and Marissa (billing ops) so we can triage and keep the invoice on hold if appropriate. Immediate next steps from our side:
- Ben will run a quick trace against the request IDs and our streaming/session-weight logs.
- Marissa will place a provisional hold on collection for the March invoice and note the ticket in our billing queue (she'll confirm the hold window and internal approvals).
- We may ask for a short set of additional request IDs if we see a client-side retry pattern.

Ben, Marissa — can you prioritize this for Monday? Priya, we'll aim to get an initial root-cause hypothesis and an ETA for credit/adjustment by EOD Tuesday (2027-04-06).

Subject: Re: Sharp spike on March invoice — need breakdown and temporary hold

Hi Priya — quick triage update. Thank you for the sample IDs. I ran those through our request trace system and pulled the surrounding session windows. Early observations:

- The requests you provided (IDs: a1f7e23, b2c9d40, c3e8f11) show multiple identical payloads arriving within milliseconds of each other for the same session_id. In our telemetry this looks like client-side retries that were accepted as separate requests by the frontend and then queued for streaming.
- During the 2027-03-30 02:00–06:00 UTC window we had a transient increase in stream-queue length on a shard servicing your region; queueing plus our session-weight policy applied a weighting multiplier to queued streaming sessions that effectively increased billed token counts for overlapping KV-cache windows. We've seen this multiplier amplify token accounting in rare cases where retries aren't deduped at the client.
- I've attached an export of the raw traces we used for this triage (redwood-trace-20270403.jsonl) and a short CSV with the events that contributed to charge amplification (sampling-extract.csv). The traces show the duplicate arrivals and the resulting session-weight increments.

Proposed immediate remediation (tentative):
1) Provisional credit: we propose to credit the overage attributable to duplicate/near-duplicate requests identified in the export. Preliminary estimate: ~72% of the delta above baseline for the two windows.
2) Invoice hold: Kimberly/Marissa, please confirm hold for March invoice until formal reconciliation completes.
3) Engineering fix: we'll open an internal SRE ticket to add a dedupe window for identical streaming requests that arrive within 250ms (short-term mitigant). Long-term we'll roll a client SDK guidance note.

Priya — if you can confirm the three sample IDs are representative, we can proceed with the provisional credit and adjust the invoice. Also, please confirm whether VAT treatment should be applied to the credit (we'll coordinate with finance).

Ben Carter
Enterprise Account Lead | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com
+1 617-555-0134

Thanks Ben — that explanation maps to what our ops team saw. Confirming the three IDs you pulled (a1f7e23, b2c9d40, c3e8f11) are from a test harness that was performing an automated retry loop due to a misconfigured backoff. We've isolated the client bug and the team has already patched the harness.

Regarding VAT: Atrato is EU-registered for VAT, but our billing entity here is the US subsidiary; for March invoice you'd treat the credit as a reduction to the taxable base. We will provide our US entity VAT status via the finance address if you need documentation.

Please proceed with the provisional credit and keep us posted on the engineering mitigant timeline. We'll accept the 250ms dedupe threshold as an interim measure.

Priya Rao
Head of Finance, Atrato AI
billing@atrato.ai

Hi Priya — thanks for confirmation and for expediting the client-side fix. Per our internal review we've done the following: 

1) Provisional hold: Redwood has placed a temporary collection hold on invoice #2027-03-AC-452 (March) effective 2027-04-04. Collections will not proceed while we complete reconciliation.
2) Provisional credit: based on Ben's trace and our cross-check, we are provisioning a credit equal to the duplicate-request amplification (~72% of the overage delta). This credit will be applied to the March invoice as a line-level adjustment; your accounts payable will receive a revised invoice draft by 2027-04-09.
3) VAT handling: we will treat the credit as a taxable line-item reduction to the invoice base. Please send any US entity VAT registration docs to finance@redwood.com and we'll ensure correct tax handling on the adjusted invoice.

Next steps & links:
- Reconciliation ticket (HubSpot): https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/company/67890 (internal ticket updated)
- Engineering mitigant: SRE ticket RDW-ENG-3497 (250ms dedupe window) — ETA for mitigation in prod: 2027-04-14.
- Revised invoice: expected 2027-04-09 (we'll attach provisional-credit-approval.pdf when available).

If this approach works for Atrato, please reply with short approval (one-line) and we'll finalize. If you need the credit issued as a separate refund instead of an invoice adjustment, let us know.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Billing Operations Manager | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com
